name: Zeus
title: King of Olympus
summary: Vaporize enemies with powerful single target attacks joining with fellow Olympians with his divine powers.
lore: The king of Olympus initially kept his focus at home after the Shattering, several romantic “attachments” beyond his borders notwithstanding. Once he engaged with the rest of Ryven, he discovered other pantheons with a stricter hierarchical nature. He has begun reshaping Olympus to match, as he believes such a change, and devotion to Order, is better for the Realm—and for him.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Place [Sharpen II] on this hero for 2 turns before attacking.
If the initial target was defeated, also increase the Divinity of all allies by 20%.
